description.summary: TARS menu model and native Cmd keys

protocol.description:
The TARS compositor (the TARS terminal) eats the Cmd chords in its own table and sends every other key to the focused client.
A client that does not bind tars_menu_manager_v1 is in compat mode: the compositor shows the Super modifier (Cmd) as Control in wl_keyboard.modifiers, so Cmd+V reaches it as Ctrl+V. A client that binds tars_menu_manager_v1 is in native mode: Cmd reaches it as Super, and Cmd+A is not Ctrl+A.
Version 1 has no menu requests yet. Binding the global is the whole message. The menu model (menu bar drawn by the compositor) is added later.

interface.name: tars_menu_manager_v1

description.summary: declares that the client takes Cmd as Super

interface.description: Binding this global puts the client in native mode for its whole life. Destroying the object does not change the mode.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the object. The client stays in native mode.
